description_en: Invokes this operation to enable the feature for detecting anomalous activity events of specified child classes
description_zh: 调用本接口开启检测子类型异常事件的功能
name: ModifyEventTypeStatus

parameters.description_en:
The unique IDs of the anomalous activity child classes, separated by commas (,).

> To enable the detection of anomalous activities of specified child classes, provide the unique IDs of the child classes. You can call the **DescribeEventTypes** operation to obtain the IDs.
parameters.description_zh:
子类型异常事件唯一标识ID，多个ID以半角逗号隔开。

> 开启SDDP检测子类型异常事件的功能，需要提供子类型异常事件唯一标识ID，该ID可调用**DescribeEventTypes**接口获取。
